or.title: SEO outreach
or.sub: The websites you ask for a link to your shop, each along the way: found, asked, answered, link live — or said no.
or.note: Links from real websites help Google trust your shop. This page only keeps your list; you write to people yourself. Nothing is sent from the shop and no money is spent.
or.offBody: Turn it on in the settings card at the bottom of this page.
or.offAsk: Ask the owner or a manager to turn SEO outreach on.

list.noPitch: Write your pitch in the settings card to get a “Write to them” button.

add.contact: Who to write to (name, e-mail or page)

edit.linkUrl: Page where your link is live
edit.linkHelp: Needed for “Link live”; it must be a page on this site.
edit.nextHelp: Empty when you mark it “Asked” = set by itself from the settings.

f.linkUrl: Page where your link is live

err.EXISTS: This site is already in the list (maybe set aside).
err.SWITCHED_OFF: SEO outreach is off. Turn it on in the settings card first.
err.NOT_FOUND: This site is no longer in the list (or it is set aside). Reload the page.
err.STALE: Someone changed this meanwhile. Reload the page and try again.
err.forbidden: You don't have permission for this.

card.d: The switch, the follow-up gap and your own pitch words.
card.readOnly: Only someone who may change marketing can change these.
card.pairHelp: Write it in both languages, or leave both empty (then there is no “Write to them” button).
card.onHelp: Off as it ships. Off, nothing can be added or changed; the list only shows.
card.followUpDaysHelp: When you mark a site “Asked” without a day, the follow-up day is set this many days later. 0 = none.
card.pitchHelp: Your first e-mail. {site} becomes the site, {shop} your shop's address. “Write to them” opens your own e-mail app with it; you press send yourself.
